errors.text_span: разположени в азбучен ред от 2009 до 2019
errors.evidence: The years on the x-axis are arranged chronologically, not alphabetically. This error is repeated later in the description.
The chart shows the value for the relative share in 2019 is 7.7%, not 8%. 8% is a tick mark on the right y-axis.
The lowest bar on the chart is for the year 2013, with a value of 134,758. The bar for 2009 (139,134) is not the lowest.
The description fails to mention the prominent thick vertical black line separating the data between the years 2014 and 2015.
